3277414.summary: Builds a list of melee attack actions against valid enemy units that could attack the buffed card, boosting the score if only one such attack exists.

3275b5c.summary: Returns the AI score for an available action, depending on its type: playing a card, melee or ranged attack, active ability or waystone click.

3278c94.summary: Returns a defensive value for a hero attacking, zeroing low scores against hero targets and returning zero for hero-versus-hero.

3278d10.summary: Returns whether a hero attacking another hero would be a suicide attack, by comparing the two heroes' current health.

3277998.summary: Determines whether the combined best attacks of all units on the same target can kill the enemy warlord, logging if so.

3277704.summary: Scores an attack by combining buffed attack score, special attack criteria, sacrifice, blast and markerlight bonuses.

32793fc.summary: Computes a card's effective attack value for a given attack type (ranged, melee or drop pod), including buffs, blind and remnant handling.

3278e04.summary: Computes a card's effective attack value for a given player action (ranged, melee or drop pod), including buffs, blind and remnant handling.

327900c.summary: Scores an attack taking temporary buffs on both attacker and target into account, including retaliation, ambush and poison bonuses.

32798f0.summary: Scores the value of damaging a unit, based on traits, health, card type and extra score from damaging or killing it.

3279450.summary: Scores the value of damaging a buffed unit, with options to ignore drop pod and to count bastion.

3279964.summary: Scores the value of healing a unit by a given amount, weighting heroes at low health and minions by their value in play.

3279ac4.summary: Returns the best buffed attack score across all potential buffed attack actions for a card.

32797cc.summary: Scores applying poison to a target, scaled by its value in play and by whether it is stunned, low on health or unable to attack.

327a170.summary: Scores returning a card to hand, based on its cost, value in play and rally or codex traits.

327a218.summary: Scores giving charge to a card: its melee attack if it is summoning sick and cannot act yet.

327a25c.summary: Scores a mana buff by counting cards, hero ability and unit abilities that become affordable with the cost change.

327a4dc.summary: Scores a buff applied to cards in hand by finding the best newly playable card and penalising already playable cards.

327a950.summary: Scores drawing a card, accounting for an empty deck (fatigue) and the room left in hand.

3276e70.summary: Sums a value for a card's active enchantment effects, adding half of stat changes and one for other qualifying effects.

3279c18.summary: Sums the AI score of every current trait on a card.

3278e58.summary: Scores playing a card now by summing target-based and non-target scoring criteria on the card.

327aa8c.summary: Decides whether the AI should play a combo card, based on the combo card being in hand, available mana and score.

327aba4.summary: Scores keeping a card in hand, scaling its extra keep score by turn number and hand size.

3277f0c.summary: Scores a scoring criteria for a card and optional target, with many scoring option cases such as damage, heal, buff, draw, stun and poison.

327ad1c.summary: Returns the unique id of a randomly chosen environment effect card from a list, or an empty string if the list is empty.

32a6960.summary: Predicate that checks whether a card's uniqueId equals the action's radio speaker card string.

32a6988.summary: Predicate that checks whether a card's uniqueId equals the action's radio speaker card string.

32a69dc.summary: Coroutine that waits a set time for a scripted action, ending early if the action can be skipped and the player skips.

32a6bc0.summary: Throws NotSupportedException because resetting this enumerator is not supported.

327b388.summary: Returns whether the current scripted action can be skipped, based on its first action data type.

327b398.summary: Returns the scripted action at the current action counter from the turn data, or null if out of range.

327b3f0.summary: Returns whether a scripted action can be skipped, based on its first action data type.

327d204.summary: Returns the before-delay or after-wait time of the current scripted action.

327d324.summary: Returns whether a scripted action has at least one action data entry.

327d388.summary: Returns whether all scripted actions in the turn have been processed.

327d3f4.summary: Returns whether the current player scripted action is waiting for the given card to be clicked.

327d808.summary: Returns whether the current player scripted action is waiting for the given card to use its ability.

327da1c.summary: Returns whether the current player scripted action is waiting for the card to change its desired attack type.
